content:
Aisha (release): Heads up — CI alerts for eu-west canary show increasing OOMs / crashes when customers hit ~30k tokens on llama3-q with runtime 3.3.0. Thinking a regional soft-pin to 3.2.1 while we triage.
Marco (runtime): Saw the same in the longseq telemetry. Suspect a kernel path change in 3.3 that mishandles KV eviction for long contexts.
Devin (qa): Repro steps I ran: load test with 4 clients, seq=32k, kept KV cache warm, saw mem spike then OOM in ~45s. Attaching trimmed log below:
Devin (qa): ```
E 03:12:14 runtime.cpp:421 - kv_cache::evict() assertion failed
E 03:12:14 runtime.cpp:442 - attempted to free non-owned page
E 03:12:14 worker.cc:88 - worker crashed: abort()
```
Priya (sdk): If we pin regionally we need to ensure SDK routing respects model->runtime mapping for hosted routes. I can push a routing override for eu-west.
Aisha (release): Plan proposal: 1) deploybot do a regional soft-pin of runtime=3.2.1 for model_family=llama3-q in eu-west only for a 2h change window; 2) Priya applies routing override; 3) Marco/Devin triage; 4) rollback plan ready if pins change customer experience. Sound OK? :eyes:
Marco (runtime): Agreed. I want a canary redirect metric to confirm no perf regressions after pin. I'll add a short eval (50 requests, varied seq lengths).
Priya (sdk): I'll update routing and add a label so Console shows the override. Will also emit an audit event.
Aisha (release): OK, deploying pin in 5 minutes. deploybot, please schedule with a 5m cooldown and include rollback hook.
deploybot: Received request to apply soft-pin. Details:
  action: pin
  runtime: 3.2.1
  model_filter: family=llama3-q
  scope: region=eu-west
  window: 2h
  cooldown: 5m
  initiated_by: Aisha (release)
deploybot: Executing pin in 30s...
ci-bot: Preflight checks: routing health OK, capacity headroom OK, no dependent hotfixes pending.
Priya (sdk): Routing override pushed. Console label: "eu-west-soft-pin-6140001111". Audit event ID: a1b2c3.
Marco (runtime): Running quick eval now. Sending results in thread.
Devin (qa): Re-ran load test after pin applied — no OOMs in 10m, KV eviction stable. Passing smoke.
Marco (runtime): Eval 50 reqs: median latency +4ms, p95 +12ms, no crashes. Looks good.
Aisha (release): Great. Keep triage open. If root cause requires longer fix we may extend pin window and notify CS. I'll post a short blurb for release notes and incident channel. :thumbsup:
Priya (sdk): Adding a follow-up ticket to SDK routing to auto-rollover pinned regions (ref: TICK-789).
Aisha (release): Thanks all — closing thread when we lift pin or escalate.
